ios.desc:
Reverse Lookup is a FREE reverse phone lookup app for iOS devices that retrieves all available information associated with a phone number. It also displays spam likeliness of any phone number. This app is a handy tool to quickly locate more information on unknown callers before you answer their calls. Currently, it works for cell, landline, toll-free, and fax phone numbers from the United States and Canada.

FEATURES:
- Find information on phone numbers
- Copy/paste numbers from the call log
- Report suspected scammers
- Block callers based on number prefix
- Completely free

To use this app, you must enter a valid 10-digit phone number, then lookup that number. The phone number you lookup can be a number issued by any carrier, including AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, etc. Reverse Lookup will retrieve information associated with that phone number instantly. This app also ensures that it has the most recent and reliable data for that number before displaying the result. If the phone number you search is a business phone number, the app will present the identity of that business.

We hope that you will find this phone number information finder tool useful. Please help this app grow by sharing it with your friends and family.
